rmhstudioslogin-desc: Signs readers in to the wiki with their rmhstudios.com account.
rmhstudioslogin-error-expired: The sign-in took too long or was started in another tab. [[Special:RMHStudiosLogin|Try again]].
rmhstudioslogin-error-invalid: The sign-in pass from rmhstudios.com was not valid. [[Special:RMHStudiosLogin|Try again]].
rmhstudioslogin-error-banned: Your rmhstudios.com account is suspended, so it cannot edit the wiki. You can still read every page.
rmhstudioslogin-error-noname: Your rmhstudios.com account has no handle yet. Choose one in your account settings on rmhstudios.com, then [[Special:RMHStudiosLogin|try again]].
rmhstudioslogin-error-create: Your wiki account could not be created: $1
rmhstudioslogin-error-unconfigured: Sign-in is not set up on this wiki.
